title: Justification-First Role Grant Flow with Audit Snapshots
creator: Asha Kapoor
description:
Summary:
Design a 'justification-first' role granting flow and inline audit snapshot preview for Console that encourages least-privilege, captures context for audit logs, and makes role changes reviewable and reversible.

Goals:
- Surface required justification for any elevated role grants (P2+ roles) when performed via Console.
- Provide an auditable preview showing the exact permission delta (before/after) and linked SSO/SAML attribute mappings.
- Enable a lightweight review queue for managers and security reviewers with an optional hold state.
- Allow end-users to undo recent grants (time-limited) and append retrospective notes that are recorded in the audit log.

User personas:
- Platform Admin (primary actor) who must assign cross-team roles and wants clear audit trail and rollback.
- Team Lead (requester) who may request temporary elevated access with a business justification.
- Security Reviewer who validates justifications and can approve/deny or request more info.

Scope (in):
- Console role editor modal changes: new justification step, permission-diff preview, SSO mapping visibility.
- Member assignment flows for single and bulk grants with justification capture.
- Audit snapshot UI: compact human-readable diff, timestamp, actor, justification, related PR/Runbook link.
- Soft-undo action for 24 hours after grant (revoke + audit entry).

Non-goals (out of scope):
- Full policy-as-code authoring UI.
- Automated access expiration enforcement (backend work to follow).

Acceptance criteria:
- When assigning a role flagged as 'requires justification', Console presents a required justification input with a 20-2000 char limit and tags suggestion.
- The permission preview clearly shows grant delta, including resource scope, allowed actions, and role templates expanded.
- Audit entry created contains: actor, assignee, role id, justification text, SSO mapping snapshot, timestamp, and optional link to PR/Confluence.
- Security reviewers can place a grant into 'review' state; grants in review do not take effect until approved (configurable per org).
- Undo action visible on role change card within Console for 24 hours; invoking undo revokes the grant and appends an audit note.

Design artifacts and links:
- Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/console-justification-grant-flow (prototype v1)
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RBAC/Justification+Grant+Flow+PRD
- GitHub mock PR for backend schema: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821

Open questions / trade-offs:
- Should 'review' state be opt-out for enterprise orgs or opt-in per workspace? (PM prefers opt-in; Security leans opt-out for high-risk roles.)
- How to balance friction vs audit quality: require justification for only P0/P1 or for P2 as well? Recommendation: require for P0/P1 and optional for P2 with strong prompt.
- Bulk assignments: how to capture per-user justification vs single bulk justification? Proposal: bulk applies one justification with optional per-user note fields for exceptions.

Design alternatives considered:
- Inline justification in the assignment modal (chose multi-step to make justification prominent).
- Post-hoc justification request (rejected; reduces audit integrity).
- Hard-coded role templates vs dynamic expansion (we keep dynamic expansion to show exact permission delta).

Telemetry and analytics (events):
- rbac.role_grant_attempt (actor, role_id, required_justification_bool)
- rbac.role_grant_submitted (actor, outcome: granted|queued_for_review|denied)
- rbac.role_grant_undo (actor, revocation_id)
- rbac.role_grant_review_action (reviewer, action: approve|deny|request_info)

Implementation notes for engineers (high-level):
- Backend: new audit schema fields (justification_text, sso_snapshot, prev_permissions_hash) and review-state flag. (ENG dependency listed below.)
- Console: new modal step, permission diff renderer, snackbar for undo availability.
- Security: map role IDs to 'requires_justification' flags; admin toggle in org settings.

Dependencies and blockers:
- ENG-40211: audit-schema update and API surfaces for review state and undo.
- ENG-40899: permission-diff service to expand role templates to permission lists.
- PM-2197: policy decision on default for 'requires_justification' by role tier.

Rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (beta): enable for admin workspace and a set of pilot customers; justification required for P0/P1.
- Phase 2: org settings toggle for automated review workflows and bulk options.
- Phase 3: tie into Dedicated/Private enforcement policies and automated expirations.

Usability test plan:
- 6 users (Platform Admins and Team Leads) performing grant + undo flows; measure success rate, time-on-task, and justification quality.
- Capture qualitative feedback on phrasing of justification prompt and examples.

Notes and recent updates:
- 2026-02-11: Kickoff meeting with PM (Tomás Rivera) and Eng lead (Leah Park). Agreed on initial audit schema fields.
- 2026-02-12: Low-fi prototype completed and tested with two SREs; feedback: permission diff needs clearer grouping by resource scope.

Next steps / action items:
- Design: iterate permission diff grouping and provide microcopy for justification field (Evelyn).
- PM: finalize role tiers requiring justification (Tomás).
- Eng: spike permission-diff expansion and surface SSO attribute snapshot (Leah).
- Schedule security review once high-fi mockups are complete.
